title: Trillion does it, not you
summary: Every plan Trillion gives you is checked step by step: what Trillion can do, it does, and only what truly needs you reaches you, louder until it is done.

payload.title: No more lists of things to do
payload.body: Before a plan reaches you, every step is checked. Trillion picks the nearest store, gives you the route as a button, prints on your printer, books the time and writes the emails. Anything that costs money or reaches someone is one tap, with its price.

payload.title: Only what needs you
payload.body: What only you can do stays here, each with the button that does it. The longer it waits, the louder it gets: your lock screen and Live Activity, the Mac menu bar, then Trillion opens it for you.
